enabled.title: Check groups by schedule
enabled.description: Every few minutes probe each member of each output group. Off - only on request.

interval.title: Check every, minutes
interval.description: How often members are probed. The schedule ticks every five minutes, so shorter values behave as five.

dead_after.title: Member is dead after failures in a row
dead_after.description: A member that failed this many probes in a row is called dead; fewer - unstable.

history.title: History entries per group
history.description: How many of the latest verdict changes and core events are kept for each group. The history lives in memory and is lost on reboot.
